hero.title: The Polygood® Kitchen Edit
hero.subtitle: The life of a worktop, from the workshop to a busy office pantry, told in four kitchens.
hero.intro: This edition follows one worktop through its life in four chapters: shaped in the workshop, fitted in the kitchen, lived in at home and shared at work. Each chapter is a real kitchen in Polygood® and shows what the material does at that stage.
hero.image_alt: Close-ups from four Polygood projects: a wave-cut Terrazzo Nuovo worktop edge, an Emerald Ghost table, a White Lollipop worktop and a Timeless Duo Blue countertop

headline: Kitchens, and the makers behind them
intro: This edition follows one worktop through its life in four chapters: shaped in the workshop, fitted in the kitchen, lived in at home and shared at work. Each chapter is a real kitchen in Polygood® and shows what the material does at that stage.

cases.title: Thermoformed kitchen
cases.headline: The curve
cases.body: Curves are hard in most worktop materials: they are built from pieces, and every joint is a line to keep clean. Samji Studio heated an Emerald Ghost panel until it softened, bent it into a curve and made the table to match. A bend instead of a joint.
cases.image_alt: Emerald Ghost table and kitchen worktop in a Paris flat with a concrete ceiling, timber cabinets and herringbone parquet

cases.title: Maison Kyka
cases.headline: The edge
cases.body: On many worktops the front edge is a strip glued over the core, and it is often the first thing to lift. Polygood is solid all the way through and needs no edge protection. Samji Studio made the Terrazzo Nuovo worktops for two Maison Kyka flats, and in one cut the edge into a wave and left it bare.
cases.image_alt: Compact Maison Kyka kitchen in Paris with beige cabinets, wavy timber handles and a Terrazzo Nuovo worktop with a wave-cut edge

cases.title: Station Road
cases.headline: Stains and care
cases.body: A white worktop is the one clients hesitate over. In our stain test with 20 everyday agents, most left no trace on Polygood, and a mark that stays can be sanded out. WUNSCH fitted this one in White Lollipop. Daily care is a pH-neutral cleaner, with a trivet for hot pans.
cases.image_alt: Kitchen run on Station Road with a White Lollipop worktop, mustard-yellow and birch-ply fronts, green glazed tiles and a brass tap

cases.title: Commerzbank
cases.headline: Daily use at work
cases.body: In an office, the pantry is where the day happens: coffee between meetings, lunch, a queue at the sink. For the Amsterdam office of Commerzbank, one of Germany's largest banks, CBRE Design Collective chose Polygood Timeless Duo Blue for the pantry countertops. It absorbs no moisture, so the sink sits under the countertop with the cut-out edge left bare. It is tested for food contact and carries a 10-year limited warranty for interior use.
cases.image_alt: Commerzbank's Amsterdam pantry with two islands topped in Timeless Duo Blue, stools, teal cabinets and a lounge area

partner.heading: Your workshop could write the next chapter
partner.body:
Every kitchen in this story came from a workshop or design studio working with Polygood. We'd like to make the next ones with you: kitchen studios, cabinetmakers and worktop fabricators.

You get a material your workshop can cut, shape and finish with standard tools, and a team behind it: free sample boxes for industry professionals, advice on your project, our technical guide and adhesive matrix, custom pattern development, and a take-back programme for the next refit.
